tagline: The Pearl of the Danube — thermal bath palaces, ruin bars in crumbling mansions, and the most photographed parliament in Europe.
overview: Budapest is two cities — hilly Buda and flat Pest — stitched across the Danube by the Chain Bridge. Castle Hill's Fisherman's Bastion gives the fairy-tale view, while the Parliament's neo-Gothic facade lights up the river at night like a wedding cake.

The city sits on 120 thermal springs, and bathing is a way of life: Széchenyi's yellow palace hosts chess players in steaming outdoor pools even in snow. After dark, the Jewish Quarter's 'ruin bars' — pubs built inside crumbling pre-war buildings — made Budapest's nightlife famous.
Speed's 2024 tour streamed from Budapest. Prices remain some of Europe's friendliest — a thermal bath, a chimney cake and a river cruise cost less than dinner in Paris.

funFacts.title: TWO CITIES, ONE RIVER
funFacts.text: Buda and Pest united only in 1873 — the Chain Bridge sealed the bond in 1849.

funFacts.title: THE BATH CITY
funFacts.text: 120+ thermal springs feed 15 public baths — Széchenyi is the largest in Europe.

funFacts.title: CHESS IN THE POOL
funFacts.text: Regulars play chess on floating boards in Széchenyi's steaming outdoor pool.

funFacts.title: RUIN BARS
funFacts.text: Szimpla Kert pioneered bars inside derelict buildings — now a worldwide trend.

funFacts.title: THE PARLIAMENT
funFacts.text: The 268-metre Gothic parliament took 17 years and 40 million bricks.

funFacts.title: THE SHOES MEMORIAL
funFacts.text: Iron shoes on the Danube bank honour Jews shot into the river in 1944.

funFacts.title: A FISHERMAN'S BASTION
funFacts.text: The seven turrets represent the seven Magyar tribes — it was never a fort, just a viewpoint.

funFacts.title: CHIMNEY CAKES
funFacts.text: Kürtőskalács — dough spirals roasted over coals — perfume the winter markets.

funFacts.title: A HILL OF CAVES
funFacts.text: Buda's limestone hides a thermal cave system open to tours.

funFacts.title: EUROPE'S OLDEST METRO
funFacts.text: The M1 line (1896) is the continent's oldest underground railway.
